characters.name: Calder Rhys
characters.description: Major, Aegis Detachment Seven. Cocky, decorated, and responsible for the people under his voice. He bullied Ivo Maren at St. Briony and does not recognize the man he is assigned to keep alive.

characters.name: Ivo Maren
characters.description: Dr. I. Maren, asset ORCHID. A composed field scientist of anomalous biology who recognizes Calder instantly and says nothing. Curiosity overrides his fear until Calder is the one bleeding.

characters.name: Nia Okonkwo
characters.description: Captain and second-in-command. Sarcastic, precise, and haunted by a civilian she failed to keep inside a perimeter.

characters.name: Mateo Solano
characters.description: Sergeant medic. Blunt and devoted. Bonded to archaeologist Anouk Solano, and professional enough to hate that the bond matters in the field.

characters.name: Jun Park
characters.description: Corporal and sniper. Quiet, exact, bonded to Harun Dalca. Says less than he sees.

characters.name: Harun Dalca
characters.description: Sergeant, heavy weapons. Loud loyalty over a fear of enclosed stone. Bonded to Jun Park.

characters.name: Sable Venn
characters.description: Lieutenant, reconnaissance. Competitive and suspicious of analysts. Falls for Ellis Ward because he is right about the living world.

characters.name: Rhee Amari
characters.description: Specialist. Engineer and communications. Clever enough to delay a warning, and honest enough to pay for it.

characters.name: Anouk Solano
characters.description: Archaeologist. Argumentative, evidence-faithful, bonded to Mateo. Fights Hester Lang about whether the city was a temple or a laboratory.

characters.name: Priya Raman
characters.description: Linguist of the Selenqari knot-script. Ivo's friend and the only person on the expedition who knows what Calder was to him before the jungle.

characters.name: Ellis Ward
characters.description: Field biologist. Talks to specimens. Carries cardamom. Learns he is not dead weight because the animals tell the truth to him first.

characters.name: Jonah Abebe
characters.description: Medical researcher for suppressants, venom, and the ethics of both. Keeps the designation protocols from becoming excuses.

characters.name: Hester Lang
characters.description: Historian and occult specialist. Knew Pavel Ruiz of the lost Survey Lantern. Wants the city preserved and learns preservation is not the same as ringing the Bell.

characters.name: Tomas Ibarra
characters.description: Virelian liaison captain. Decent, interested in Ivo, and wise enough to take his people back when the Reach starts answering.

characters.name: Adrien Cho
characters.description: Director of Helix Meridian. Former Compact cartographer who believes leaving the Marrow unasked is vanity that will cost millions of lives.

characters.name: Leona Varga
characters.description: Helix field commander. Her brother died in a classified anomaly. She wants a reason more than a weapon, and still steals what she can carry.

characters.name: Pavel Ruiz
characters.description: Lead of the lost Survey Lantern expedition. He learned not to ask the Marrow what it wants. The jungle is still repeating him.
